name: FirstStep
what_it_does: Drop-in onboarding for hackathon web apps. Paste one script tag, describe your product in three sentences, and FirstStep generates a first-run walkthrough, empty-state copy, and a two-step setup checklist that adapts to what the user has already done.
target_user: Builders whose demo works but whose first-time users stall on the first screen.
strengths: Understood immediately by 82 percent of reviewers, which is the metric the product exists to improve for others.
Works on any site with one script tag. Reviewers installed it on their own builds during the swipe session.
Generated walkthroughs adapt to what the user has already done instead of replaying the same tour.

agent_observations.note: Reviewers understood it immediately (0.82) and found it easy to use (0.76), but feels_distinctive sits at 0.47. The core capability, onboarding, is strong. The product itself looks like a generic tour library. This is a product whose strength is exactly the kind of gap other products in the pool report.
